subject: design/solution-shape-v1
statement: The design and its shape are authored as a pair and reviewed on **one page** produced by extending the existing doc-review render seam to accept a design together with its paired shape (the human face, AP-6) — not a new tool. The render is a pure function of the two source files, so what the reviewer sees is exactly what freezes (the design) beside what stays live (the shape); nothing is transformed or invented in the render (this is what makes the co-render trustworthy — R1). Approval is one gate over the pair; only the design's approval is a freezing event.
